C. Oxidation to alcohols - This reaction can occur with many types of hydrocarbons, including alkenes and alkynes, so it is not unique to acetylene.

D. Polymerization - This reaction can occur with alkenes and alkynes, including acetylene, but it is not exclusive to acetylene.
